en.title: Parmigiana-Style Stuffed Eggplant
en.description: A clever, hearty twist on a classic. These eggplant shells are packed with a savory mixture of roasted pulp, rich tomato sauce, and gooey mozzarella, then baked until perfectly tender and bubbly.

en.title: Crispy Frozen Potato Wedges
en.description: The ultimate effortless side dish. Cooked directly from the freezer, these wedges achieve a fluffy, steaming interior and a satisfyingly golden, crisp exterior without the need for extra oil.

en.title: Parmesan & Garlic Spiced Wedges
en.description: Rustic, bold, and full of flavor. These thick-cut wedges are tossed in a savory blend of Parmesan cheese, garlic, and onion powder, then roasted to a perfect golden crunch.

en.title: Perfect Whole Baked Potatoes
en.description: The gold standard of comfort food. Enjoy a classic jacket potato with an incredibly shatter-crisp skin and a soft, pillowy interior that's ready for your favorite toppings.

en.title: Roasted Baby Potatoes with Spicy Dip
en.description: Bite-sized perfection. These herb-seasoned baby potatoes are roasted until the skins are snappy and served with a creamy, zesty spicy mayonnaise for the ultimate dipping experience.

en.title: Golden Hash Brown Patties
en.description: Start your morning with a crunch. These classic potato patties are cooked to a beautiful golden-brown finish using rapid air circulation, keeping them light, crispy, and oil-free.

en.title: Buttery Hasselback Potatoes
en.description: Elegant and eye-catching. Thinly sliced but held together at the base, these potatoes fan out as they bake, allowing seasoned butter to seep into every layer for a crispy outside and melt-in-your-mouth inside.

en.title: Herb-Roasted Baby Potatoes
en.description: A versatile and wholesome side. These tiny potatoes are roasted at high heat with fresh herbs until the exteriors are crispy and the centers are buttery and tender.

en.title: Charred Whole Roasted Bell Peppers
en.description: A kitchen essential made easy. High heat blisters and chars the skins to perfection, resulting in a sweet, tender, and smoky pulp that's perfect for salads, sauces, or sides.

en.title: Crunchy Air-Fried Onion Rings
en.description: All the crunch of the deep-fryer with a fraction of the oil. These onion rings feature a thick, seasoned coating that air-fries to a loud, golden-brown finish.

en.title: Smoky Candied BBQ Bacon
en.description: The ultimate sweet and salty snack. Thick-cut bacon is glazed with sugar and spices, then caramelized until it forms a glass-like, smoky-sweet crust that's completely addictive.

en.title: Sweet & Mustard Crusted Steaks
en.description: A flavor powerhouse. Intense heat sears the steak while rapidly melting a sweet mustard rub into a robust, aromatic crust that locks in all the succulent juices.

en.title: Charred Brussels Sprouts & Pancetta
en.description: Sophisticated and savory. High-heat roasting chars the outer leaves of the sprouts while rendering the salty pancetta fat, coating every bite in a rich, smoky flavor.

en.title: Light & Crispy Kale Chips
en.description: The ultimate guilt-free snack. Transform fresh kale into paper-thin, shatteringly crisp chips in minutes—a healthy, salty alternative to traditional potato chips.

en.title: Crispy Dehydrated Apple Chips
en.description: Naturally sweet and wholesome. Low-temperature dehydration turns fresh apple slices into crisp, concentrated bites of fruit that are perfect for snacking on the go.

en.title: Rustic Pear & Walnut Galette
en.description: Effortlessly elegant. This free-form tart features a flaky, buttery crust folded over sweet sliced pears, finished with a drizzle of honey and a crunch of toasted walnuts.

en.title: Crisp-Tender Roasted Green Beans
en.description: A vibrant and simple side. Roasting at high temperatures eliminates excess moisture, leaving you with green beans that are snappy, tender, and beautifully browned.

en.title: Golden Spiced Chickpea Falafel
en.description: Authentic flavor made light. These falafels feature a moist, herb-spiced interior and a perfectly golden-brown, crisp exterior without the need for deep-frying.

en.title: Greek-Style Feta & Oregano Fries
en.description: A Mediterranean twist on a favorite. Crispy fries are tossed with salty crumbled feta, fresh parsley, and aromatic oregano for a bold and savory side dish.

en.title: Perfectly Golden Curly Fries
en.description: Fun, crunchy, and hassle-free. Get evenly cooked, golden-brown spirals directly from the freezer to your plate without a drop of extra oil.
